description: The person's global risk limits (per-trade risk, daily / weekly / monthly loss, drawdown, leverage, open positions) and how much of each is used, across all exchanges, plus limit increases waiting to take effect. Use when a trade was rejected by a user-level limit or before planning several trades. Not for this agent's own permissions (use get_my_trading_permissions). No inputs. Fractions of equity and USD; real money and the sandbox are counted separately. Next: size_position_by_risk.
name: get_my_risk_limits_usage
